test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The volume of a solid cylindered rod is 2750 cm³. If the length of the rod is 35 cm, then find the base radius (in cm) of the cylindrical rod. (use π = 22/7)
solution:
Formula used:

V = π × r2 × h where,

"r" is the radius, "V" is the volume of a cylinder, and "h" is the height of the cylinder.

Calculation:

Substituting the values,

2750 = 3.14 × r2 × 35

⇒ r = sqrt {2750 times 7 over {{22}×35}} ~~ = 5 cm

∴ The radius is 5 cm.
